pairs.subject: scoring-rubrics
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:124 feeds signal.successRate into the heaviest (0.30) dimension ignoring successRateSource, which src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:415 sets to 100 for an unmeasured persona, so an idle agent collects full marks; re-judged per technique 2026-10-10 (5 of 7 deviate, code unchanged since 2026-10-05)

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:124 success dimension takes the 100 that src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:415 assigns when successRateSource is unknown (absence as the ceiling); speed/cost are correctly dropped and renormalized at src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:136, but no coverage travels with the score and no coverage floor refuses to rank

src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/components/LeaderboardMatrixView.tsx:262 cell renders only the normalized value: no weight, no contribution, no raw unit, no coverage; a missing speed/cost renders as the neutral 50 from src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:71 instead of as absent
src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:58 vector is one declaration (good) but carries no per-weight rationale, no sum assertion and no rubric version

src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:107 computeLeaderboard has no golden fixtures (git ls-files finds no leaderboard test), and src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/components/leaderboardViewHelpers.ts:42 re-implements the 80/60/40 bands of src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:97 as a second copy

src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:182 ties break on successRate with no stable-identity final key (same at src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardRanking.ts:51), and no entry carries a gap list or a top gap named as an action

src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:71 speed/cost are cohort-relative (fleet average), polarity-inverted and clamped, which suits a ranking surface, but the frame is not shown to the reader and activity uses the raw fleet max, so one outlier compresses everyone else
src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:58 one weight vector grades one population (personas); no per-class weighting exists or is claimed

pairs.registryProposal: score-explanation rule "never band a dimension with the composite thresholds" fires here (src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/components/LeaderboardMatrixView.tsx:258 applies scoreTint to every dimension cell and the composite alike); consider a node/react application citing this as the per-dimension-banding failure shape. Also: the context-map entry point LeaderboardPage.tsx was deleted on 2026-08-25 (tab retired, surface moved to sub_missionControl/sections/LeaderboardSection.tsx), so the context paths miss the live consumer.
